description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game, targeting any artifact.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating a token copy of Basalt Monolith and any other artifact(s) as applicable.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {C}.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 4.
